name: Traditional Chinese Localization
author: Community
description: Converts Black Book's built-in Simplified Chinese localisation to Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) using OpenCC s2twp, with reviewed terminology corrections. Replaces the StreamingAssets/Config config_zh.yaml files; no plugins or runtime translators required.

coverage.note: Converts the 1,448 config_zh.yaml files (3,479 strings). Text baked into data.unity3d (menus, settings, tooltips, dialogue) is NOT converted and stays Simplified Chinese. See README.md > Coverage.

install.requiresNote: Requires the BepInEx 5 framework mod (winhttp.dll + BepInEx/core). Black Book is Unity 2018.4 Mono, so BepInEx 5 x64 - not BepInEx 6 IL2CPP.
install.notes: Only config_zh.yaml files are written under Black Book_Data; the game's config.yaml and config_en/ja/ko.yaml are untouched. Every .yaml file in the package is deployed to its recorded path relative to the game root.
